title: Sweet Chilli Tofu & Veggie Fried Rice Bar
subtitle: with Sesame Fried Eggs & Crispy Shallots
description: Create your perfect rice bowl for dinner tonight with Asian-spiced tofu, steamed greens and a sesame fried egg and all your favourite toppings - like tomato wedges and crispy shallots. Fresh, customisable and full of flavour!

steps.text:
• Boil the kettle. Half-fill a medium saucepan with boiling water.
• Add jasmine rice and a pinch of salt and cook, uncovered, over high heat until tender, 12-14 minutes. Drain, rinse with warm water and set aside.

• Meanwhile, chop broccoli (including stalk!) into small florets. Finely chop garlic, carrot and brown onion (see ingredients). Cut tomato into thin wedges.
• Cut plain tofu (see ingredients) into 2cm chunks.
• In a medium bowl, combine tofu, Asian BBQ seasoning and a drizzle of olive oil.
• Add broccoli and a splash of water to a microwave-safe bowl, then cover with a damp paper towel.
• Microwave broccoli on high until just tender, 2-4 minutes.
• Drain broccoli, then return to the bowl. Season to taste and cover to keep warm.

• When the rice is done, in a large frying pan heat a drizzle of olive oil over high heat. Cook carrot and onion until tender, 4-5 minutes.
• Reduce heat to medium, add garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute. Add cooked rice, soy sauce mix and a drizzle of sesame oil stirring well to combine.
• Transfer to a serving bowl, season with pepper and cover to keep warm.

• Return frying pan to medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil.
• When oil is hot, crack the eggs into the pan and sprinkle with mixed sesame seeds. Cook until egg whites are firm and yolks are cooked to your liking, 4-5 minutes.
• Transfer to a plate and cover to keep warm.

• Return frying pan to medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil.
• When the oil is hot, cook tofu, turning occasionally, 4-5 minutes.
• Add sweet chilli sauce and cook, turning to coat, until fragrant, 1 minute. Transfer to a serving bowl.

• Bring everything to the table.
• Build your own plate with fried rice, sweet chilli tofu, steamed broccoli, tomato, crispy shallots and sesame fried egg.
• If you've selected an add on bundle, serve with stir-fried Asian greens. Enjoy!
